posts.text: One thing Michael Ogg and I wanted to explore was how software and hardware actually come together in something real. So we built a face-tracking turret using Python, OpenCV, and Arduino. The setup uses a camera to detect and track faces in real time, then sends pan and tilt commands to a servo turret over serial so it can follow a target. Tech Stack: - Python - OpenCV - Arduino - PySerial What I learned most from this project was how much embedded systems work happens at the intersection of cod
